name: foundry-iphone-mirror
description: Drive a real iPhone from your Mac through macOS iPhone Mirroring: screenshot the phone, read it, tap, type, swipe, verify. Ships a skill (the screenshot-read-act-verify loop), an iphone-driver subagent, a stdlib MCP server with typed iphone_* tools, a CLI on PATH, and a doctor. Use it for real-device iOS QA and for on-phone tasks with no Mac-side API. Proven engine, port not yet device-tested.
